newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bandai to delay signing of Sega merger deal--paper.
newsitem.headline: Bandai to delay signing of Sega merger deal--paper.

text.p: Bandai Co Ltd's board of directors has voted to postpone the signing of a merger agreement with Sega Enterprises Ltd to July from before the end of May as originally scheduled, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Monday.

Bandai, whose business has recently been buoyed by the huge popularity of its "Tamagotchi" electronic pet toy, decided to postpone the merger as some of its middle-ranked managers remain strongly opposed to it, the paper said.
The two companies said earlier that they planned to merge on October 1.
A Bandai spokeswoman was not immediately available to comment.
